AMD RYZEN 9 9950X3D

The AMD Ryzen 9 9950X3D is a 16-core, 32-thread desktop processor designed for high-end gaming and content creation. Part of the Ryzen 9000 series, it utilizes the Zen 5 "Granite Ridge" architecture and features AMD's 2nd-generation 3D V-Cache technology. It was announced at CES 2025 and released on March 12, 2025.

Key Features

  • 3D V-Cache: The processor includes an additional 64MB of 3D V-Cache stacked on one of its core complex dies (CCDs), bringing the total L3 cache to 128MB. This technology is designed to reduce latency for enhanced gaming performance and other bandwidth-sensitive tasks.
  • Dual-CCD design: The 9950X3D is built with two CCDs, but only one is equipped with the 3D V-Cache. This allows the non-cache CCD to operate at higher clock speeds, improving overall performance.
  • High thermal headroom: Unlike some previous X3D chips, the 9950X3D has a higher thermal design power (TDP) of 170W, giving it more thermal headroom for higher clock speeds. This higher power limit is possible due to a repositioning of the 3D V-Cache, which helps it run cooler.
  • Improved efficiency tuning: The processor offers the flexibility to adjust power settings, with an "Eco Mode" that allows users to reduce power consumption while giving up minimal gaming performance.

AMD RYZEN 9 9900X3D

The AMD Ryzen 9 9900X3D is a 12-core, 24-thread desktop processor from the Ryzen 9000 series, based on the Zen 5 "Granite Ridge" architecture. It is optimized for gaming and content creation, utilizing AMD's 2nd-gen 3D V-Cache technology. Announced at CES 2025, it was released on March 12, 2025, alongside the Ryzen 9 9950X3D.

Key Features

  • Performance-optimized design: The 9900X3D is built with two core complex dies (CCDs), with one featuring a large 3D V-Cache and the other designed for higher clock speeds. This "middle child" processor is intended to offer the best of both worlds: high gaming performance from the extra cache and strong multi-core performance for productivity from the other cores.
  • Overclocking support: Unlike previous generations of X3D processors, the 
    Ryzen 9 9900X3D is fully unlocked for overclocking, offering enthusiasts more control over performance
  • High efficiency: With a 120W Thermal Design Power (TDP), the 9900X3D is more energy-efficient than the flagship 9950X3D, while still offering exceptional gaming speeds.
  • Dual-purpose performance: Reviews indicate that while the 9900X3D is the fastest 12-core gaming chip on the market, it is also a competent all-around processor for productivity tasks, offering a balance of performance.
